title: HelperSSHForwardResult
description: The listener's identity and the address the server BOUND. `bind.port` is the port the server allocated — a requested 0 is resolved there and never reported as 0 — and `bind.host` is the transport's answer rather than a verified bind (the remote strategy's own caveat has always disclosed this, and the wire does not improve on the protocol).

forward.description: The listener id, as 32 hex characters. Minted by the helper — the end that owns the listener — and echoed verbatim by the coordinator on the unforward and in every announcement about it. It is a DIFFERENT identity from a channel id: a channel is a stream somebody holds and a listener is what streams arrive on, and the two are ended by different ops.

bind.description: The address the server bound. The port is the allocated one; the host is whatever the reply carried, which for a hostname bind is an all-interfaces answer rather than proof of what was bound.
